Azure Pipelines:
There may be pipelines that require an authorized user to comment /azp run to run.

Hi alexcastgonz,thanks for taking the time to submit this PR! Our team already has plans for the issues we open, and we’ll address them ourselves. To avoid duplicating work, we’ll close this PR.
If you’re interested in contributing to the project, we’d love to hear what you notice as you use it. If you run into a bug or see something we could improve, please feel free to open an issue. Thanks again for contributing!
